name: Obsidian Open Mind, made by Galion
theme: obsidian: deep volcanic black glass, one restrained sky accent
source: Core hexes reused from the earlier Galion release kit: /opt/galion/openmind/release/brand/BRAND.md (section 4) and release/site/style.css. Facet shades are darker steps of Ink/Surface used only inside the logo mark and banner.

ink.role: primary dark background; body text on light

surface.role: raised panel and code block on dark

line.role: hairlines and borders on dark; brightest logo facet

text.role: body text on dark (16.27:1 on ink)

mist.role: muted text on dark (9.27:1 on ink)

slate.role: logo outline; neutral accent on both themes (4.24:1 on ink, 4.29:1 on paper)

sky.role: the one accent on dark: open ring, links, focus (9.84:1 on ink); never text on light (1.85:1)

ocean.role: accent on light: links and buttons (6.23:1 on paper)

paper-muted.role: muted text on light (8.33:1 on paper)

mono.fallback: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
